changes: The dev failures were mostly submissions made after 2 model calls with no `run_tests` or brute-force check; the solver often claimed correctness by hand. I added a HARD RULE to `/agent/solver.md` that blocks `submit` until the public examples pass via `run_tests` and at least one brute-force comparison has run, plus a short list of common slips to check. `validate()` passes, and a trial on lcb-abc387-f (previously failed) now passes with the verification steps run. I did not re-run the other failures, so the gain is unconfirmed beyond that one case.
final:
